## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes with no warnings
- [ ] New behaviour has a test (unit, or end-to-end for a user flow)
- [ ] No subject content, textbooks, exams or personal data in the diff
- [ ] No new network calls (see "Hard rules" in `CONTRIBUTING.md`)
- [ ] UI changes work in light and dark, with the keyboard, and at 1280×800
